_comment: Reactors. Steady and Surge are mutually exclusive branches after Fission Cell II.

items.name: Fission Cell I
items.description: Standard ship reactor. Output feeds shields and the weapon energy pool; the capacitor is the size of that pool.

items.name: Fission Cell II
items.description: Standard ship reactor. Output feeds shields and the weapon energy pool; the capacitor is the size of that pool.

items.name: Lattice Reactor I
items.description: Steady branch: high constant output, small capacitor. Best for sustained fire and fast shield recharge.
